annotations.title: Cubic feet and cubic metres of a shipment

description: Total volume of up to 20 lines of identical pieces, in cubic feet, cubic metres, cubic inches, cubic yards and litres. Each item has length, width, height in unit (in, ft, yd, mm, cm or m; default in) and quantity (default 1). When every item has a weight, also returns total weight, density in lb/ft³ and kg/m³, and ocean weight/measurement (the larger of m³ and tonnes). weight is per piece unless weightBasis is line. rounding (default exact) can round each side up or to the nearest whole inch first.

height.description: Height of one piece, in unit

length.description: Length of one piece, in unit

weight.description: Weight in weightUnit, per piece unless weightBasis is line. Give it on every item or on none

width.description: Width of one piece, in unit

rounding.description: exact, ceil-in (each side up to a whole inch) or nearest-in

name: calculate_cube
